personality_one_liner: Cinematic, rich, and deeply immersive—putting the album art and music front and center through frosted glass, moody dark negative space, and amber accents.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Cinematic layouts require breathing room. Cards and lists must feel collected, not cramped.

do's: Use heavy blur overlaid with >=75% tint opacity of `surfaceSecondary` for the Now Playing full-screen backdrop.
Apply frosted glass to the floating mini-player over scrolling home/library content.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar when scrolling content flows underneath.
Apply glassmorphic headers when lists scroll beneath them.
dont's: Never put thin serif typography on raw blur without a tinted background layer.
Do not use glass on normal list rows or standard content cards.
Do not stack more than two glass surfaces per screen.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A premium personalized dashboard surfacing recent music, top played, and quick library shortcuts.

states.loading: Skeleton grids with shimmering surfaceSecondary blocks.
states.empty: N/A for Home, empty sections just don't render.
states.error: Centered subtle error text with a retry icon.

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical layout. Large 'Recently Played' carousel at the top (full-bleed cards). Below that, quick-access chips in a horizontal scroll (Songs, Artists, Albums). Then 'Most Played' and 'Recently Added'. Mini-player anchored above the bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: The core repository for all local files, organized by category.

states.empty: Illustration of a vinyl record with 'No music found. Pull to rescan or check local files.' and a primary CTA 'Scan Folder'.
states.error: Error scanning directory message with retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with segmented sub-navigation. Standard list rows for Songs with artwork, title, artist. Grid layout for Albums. Sectioned by alphabet.

screens.name: Now Playing (Full Screen)
screens.purpose: The immersive playback center, utilizing artwork to create a cinematic mood.

states.empty: Should not be reachable without a track.

screens.layout: Artwork-derived blurred background (using heavy blur + tint scrim). Huge square album art taking up the top 50%. Large title and artist below. Seekable progress bar. Playback controls (previous, play/pause, next, shuffle, repeat) anchored near the bottom.

screens.name: Playlists

states.empty: Illustration of an empty record sleeve with 'Create your first playlist' CTA.

screens.layout: 2-column grid. Playlist cards feature custom cover images and gradient overlays. Touching a playlist opens a detail screen with a large banner header.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Fast indexing and retrieval of local tracks.

states.empty: Recent search history chips. If no results, 'No matches found'.

screens.layout: Large search input field at the top. Results segmented by type (Songs, Albums, Artists). List rows for results.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: App configuration and local library management.
screens.layout: Standard vertical list with toggle switches and right chevrons. Sections for Appearance, Playback, and Library Management.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '6 Glass / Luxe' personality. The UI must feel expensive and cinematic.
Implement both Light and Dark themes accurately using the provided color tokens, with system toggle support.
The Now Playing screen is the focal point. Use `expo-blur` heavily, overlaid with a tinted layer of `surface` (75%+ opacity) so controls remain readable.
Do NOT use any shade of blue, navy, purple, or violet. The accent color is Amber/Antique Gold (`#EAA33A`).

Use Fraunces (Serif) strictly for large, expressive text (Album titles on detail screens, Artist names, Playlist headers). Use Satoshi (Sans-Serif) for all structural UI (lists, tabs, metadata, settings) to ensure readability.
Use `Phosphor` icons consistently. No ad-hoc SVGs or emojis in the UI.
Ensure all lists have generous touch targets (minimum 56pt) and list items are separated by subtle dividers or margin.
Mini-player MUST float above the bottom tab bar and feature a frosted glass background.
Apply gradient scrims (transparent to `surfaceInverse`) at the bottom of all image-heavy cards and album headers to guarantee text contrast.
